title: Fix race condition in SQLite connection pool retry logic
goal: Eliminate database lock timeout exceptions caused by concurrent writers during rapid burst requests
requirements: Ensure WAL mode and busy_timeout are configured on every pooled connection
Implement exponential backoff retry mechanism on sqlite3.OperationalError with jitter
Guarantee thread-safe connection checkout and release
constraints: Must not introduce external connection pool dependencies
Maximum retry duration must not exceed 5.0 seconds per transaction
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent execution test with 20 parallel threads completes with 0 OperationalError exceptions
Average connection acquisition latency remains under 50ms under peak contention

title: Resolve memory leak in streaming SSE event worker buffer
goal: Prevent unbounded memory growth in long-running event streams when clients drop connection without closing socket
requirements: Detect disconnected client sockets promptly during async generator iteration
Clear buffered queue items upon connection termination
Implement bounded circular buffer for event replay
constraints: Memory footprint of worker process must remain stable under 100MB over 24-hour operation
Must support Last-Event-ID replay up to 1000 events without disk spill
acceptance_criteria: Simulated 100 abrupt client disconnects produces zero leaked queue references in garbage collection
Process resident memory returns to baseline after idle cleanup

title: Implement JWT authentication with JWKS key rotation
goal: Support secure multi-tenant authentication via OpenID Connect JWKS public key caching and token validation
requirements: Fetch and cache public keys from well-known JWKS endpoint with 1-hour TTL
Validate RS256 token signature, expiration (exp), and audience (aud) claims
Inject authenticated tenant and user context into FastAPI request state
constraints: Must use PyJWT or cryptography library with zero known CVEs
Key refresh must handle network failures gracefully using cached fallback
acceptance_criteria: Expired or altered tokens receive HTTP 401 Unauthorized with descriptive envelope
Key rotation test validates tokens signed by new key without service restart

title: Build idempotent webhook delivery system with dead-letter queue
goal: Deliver asynchronous event notifications to external subscriber endpoints with guaranteed at-least-once delivery
requirements: Sign webhook payloads with HMAC-SHA256 signature in X-Signature header
Implement retry schedule: 1s, 5s, 30s, 5m, 1h before marking failed
Route permanently failed messages to Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) with audit record
constraints: Delivery attempts must include unique idempotency key to prevent duplicate processing
Payload size capped at 256KB
acceptance_criteria: Subscribers returning HTTP 500 trigger automatic retries per schedule
DLQ query endpoint allows inspecting and manually retrying failed deliveries

title: Refactor monolithic order processor into hexagonal domain events
goal: Decouple business logic from database schema by introducing domain aggregate roots and event dispatchers
requirements: Define pure domain Order aggregate without ORM dependencies
Publish OrderCreated, PaymentReceived, and OrderFulfilled domain events
Implement repository interface for clean persistence port
constraints: Domain layer must have zero imports from external database frameworks
Maintain 100% backward compatibility with public REST API endpoints
acceptance_criteria: All domain operations can be unit tested entirely in-memory without database mocks
Event subscribers execute asynchronously without blocking order placement

title: Migrate legacy synchronous worker threads to asyncio event loop pool
goal: Increase task concurrency from 20 threads to 500 concurrent async coroutines without thread contention
requirements: Replace blocking socket operations with non-blocking async counterparts
Introduce asyncio.Semaphore to bound concurrent network operations
Handle cancellation and TaskGroup structured concurrency cleanly
constraints: Compatible with Python 3.11+ asyncio without third-party loop runners
CPU-bound tasks must be offloaded to ThreadPoolExecutor
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark demonstrates 5x throughput increase under 500 simultaneous connections
Zero unhandled TaskWasDestroyedPending warnings in test suite

title: Migrate relational database schema from raw SQL to Alembic migrations
goal: Establish repeatable, versioned database schema migration pipeline with automated rollback verification
requirements: Generate baseline Alembic migration representing current production schema
Ensure migrations run idempotently and safely within database transactions
Implement downgrade scripts for every schema revision
constraints: Zero downtime schema changes; no table locks exceeding 100ms
Must support SQLite (dev) and PostgreSQL (prod) dialect compatibility
acceptance_criteria: Running alembic upgrade head and alembic downgrade base in CI passes cleanly
Schema diff validation confirms zero unintended column or index mutations

title: Upgrade FastAPI backend sync handlers to async coroutines
goal: Modernize API route handlers to leverage asynchronous IO, reducing response latency under load
requirements: Convert def route handlers doing IO to async def with awaitable database calls
Ensure thread pool context is used for any unavoidable legacy synchronous calls
Update test client fixtures to utilize httpx.AsyncClient
constraints: OpenAPI schema specifications must remain 100% identical
No regression in error envelope structure or status codes
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint latency P99 drops by at least 30% under simulated 100 rps load
All API integration tests pass with 0 warnings

title: Design real-time metrics telemetry streaming with undefined retention policy
goal: Clarify requirements and design high-volume system metrics streaming pipeline with rolling window storage
requirements: Formulate explicit questions regarding retention period, resolution tiering, and downsampling
Design flexible storage adapter supporting either SQLite timeseries or Redis time series
Implement configurable retention policy with default 7-day raw / 30-day aggregated retention
constraints: Ingestion pipeline must sustain up to 5,000 metrics events/sec without backpressure loss
Storage footprint per day must not exceed 2GB
acceptance_criteria: Clarification questions submitted through Human-in-the-loop workflow
Plan specifies automated data pruning job and aggregation rollups

title: Design distributed cache layer with unclear cache invalidation semantics
goal: Resolve ambiguities in distributed caching requirements and implement consistent write-through caching strategy
requirements: Identify potential cache inconsistency risks across read-heavy multi-region nodes
Propose Lease-based or TTL-based invalidation with pub/sub invalidation broadcast
Provide fallback to direct database query on cache miss or partition
constraints: Cache hit ratio target >= 95% for hot query paths
Stale read window must not exceed 500ms under normal network conditions
acceptance_criteria: Planner-Reviewer discussion resolves invalidation strategy into formal ADR
Simulated cache failure triggers graceful fallback without request failure

title: Design distributed rate limiting service with sliding window log
goal: Architect standalone microservice to enforce token bucket or sliding window rate limits across distributed API gateways
requirements: Support per-client and per-route rate limit configuration (e.g. 100 req/min)
Implement sliding window log algorithm using Redis sorted sets or atomic Lua script
Return standardized HTTP 429 response with Retry-After and X-RateLimit headers
constraints: Rate limit check latency must be strictly under 5ms (P99)
High availability: fallback to permissive mode if Redis becomes unreachable
acceptance_criteria: Boundary tests confirm exact rate limit enforcement at threshold + 1 requests
Circuit breaker test verifies service continues serving traffic if rate limiter times out

title: Design tamper-evident audit logging service with cryptographic hash chaining
goal: Build enterprise-grade compliance audit log service where records are cryptographically chained to prevent alteration
requirements: Each audit record includes timestamp, actor, action, payload hash, and previous record hash
Maintain Merkle root anchor periodically published or stored immutably
Provide verification utility to detect any record tampering or deletion
constraints: Append-only storage with strict permission fencing
Audit logs must be retained for at least 7 years per regulatory compliance
acceptance_criteria: Integrity verification algorithm correctly identifies modified byte in chained records
Audit service throughput reaches at least 1,000 recorded events/sec
